function.name: check_meeting_availability
function.description: Check calendars of the listed attendees only. Collect title, attendee names, date, time and duration. Clarify ambiguous names. Never creates meetings or requires caller phone numbers.

title.description: Meeting title supplied by the caller.

attendees.description: Attendee names. Use a selected directory email after clarification. Include everyone whose calendar should be checked.

date.description: Date as spoken: today, tomorrow, next Monday, another weekday, in N days, or YYYY-MM-DD. The backend resolves relative dates using the current time in the selected timezone.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA timezone. Defaults to America/New_York unless configured otherwise.

time.description: Start time such as 14:00 or 2 PM. Ask for AM/PM when ambiguous.

description.description: Optional plain-text agenda or description, only when provided or requested by the caller. Do not invent it. Tool 2 must copy the exact description checked by Tool 1; recheck if it changes.

location.description: Optional physical meeting location or room, only when supplied by the caller. Copy the exact location from Tool 1 into Tool 2. This label does not reserve a room.
